title: Mara and the Asset
author: Yara Halloran
blurb: Sebastian Eriksen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
